message.content: The drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) depending on the exact route you take. On a typical day, without heavy traffic, you’d expect it to take around **6 hours**. In rush‑hour or holiday periods, especially near the Bay Area and the Los Angeles metro area, it can easily stretch to 7–8 hours or more. If you’re planning a trip, it’s a good idea to check real‑time traffic updates and consider leaving early in the morning or late at night to avoid the worst congestion.
